# SI060 — pattern-misuse-p1-p8

Pattern helpers must be used with a canonical return value.

## Why

P1-P8 only converge when the compared value is the documented canonical shape.

## Bad

```python
strict_eq(lambda: raw_string)
```

## Good

```python
strict_eq(evaluate)  # returns P7 aggregate
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI060 -- reason
```
